skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental knowledge of software engineering processes from requirement definition to analysis, design, testing, and maintenance of software.
Understand and apply the process of software requirement specification and develop a requirement specification report for a specific software.
Understand the foundation of software design and the software design process.
Understand and apply the process of functional analysis and design for software.
Understand and apply the process of object-oriented analysis and design for software.
Understand and apply the process of real-time systems design for software.
Understand and apply the process of software testing.
Understand and apply the process of software maintenance and build maintenance documentation.

Understand and apply the concepts and processes of software project management, including quality management, configuration management, human resource management, risk management, and software size estimation.

Develop skills in written communication, report writing, and professional presentations related to planning, strategy, and execution of assigned activities; have skills in communicating on network environments.

Develop programming skills, build databases, and apply fundamental principles of software development processes; have the ability to master technologies and techniques to develop, operate, and manage information systems serving operational, management, and administrative activities in organizations and businesses.
Have the ability to exploit specialized software to analyze data and synthesize information to support decision-making processes.
Have the ability to manage software projects.
Be able to work independently or actively, effectively participate in group activities.
Have social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Systems Management.
